```{r}
library(data.table)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
#Loading raw data:

mesmer.fp <- "NSCLC.0--mesmer_cell.csv"

main.matrix <- data.frame(fread(mesmer.fp), check.names = FALSE)

main.matrix[, "CellID"] <- paste0("CellID_", main.matrix[, "CellID"])
rownames(main.matrix) <- main.matrix[, "CellID"]

quant.matrix <- main.matrix[, 2:(grep("X_centroid", fixed = TRUE, colnames(main.matrix)) - 1)]
rownames(quant.matrix) <- main.matrix[, "CellID"]
quant.matrix <- t(quant.matrix)

centroid.matrix <- main.matrix[, c("X_centroid", "Y_centroid", "CellID")]
colnames(centroid.matrix) <- c("x", "y", "cell")

meta.matrix <- main.matrix[, colnames(main.matrix)[c(1, grep("Area", colnames(main.matrix), fixed = TRUE):ncol(main.matrix))]]
colnames(meta.matrix)[1] <- "cell_id"

data.list <- list(matrix = quant.matrix, centroids = centroid.matrix, metadata = meta.matrix)

coords <- suppressWarnings(CreateFOV(coords = data.list$centroids, type = "centroids", key = "fov", assay = "Akoya"))
colnames(data.list$metadata) <- suppressWarnings(make.names(colnames(data.list$metadata)))

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.list$matrix, assay = "Akoya", meta.data = data.list$metadata)
coords <- subset(coords, cells = Cells(obj))
suppressWarnings(obj[["fov"]] <- coords)

codex.obj <- obj
codex.obj <- NormalizeData(codex.obj, normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
codex.obj <- ScaleData(codex.obj)


#2 splitting marker panel

marker_cols <- rownames(codex.obj)
marker_cols <- setdiff(marker_cols, "Keratin_14")  

set.seed(0)
n_markers <- length(marker_cols)
shuffled_markers <- sample(marker_cols, n_markers)

clustering_markers <- shuffled_markers[1:floor(n_markers / 2)]
validation_markers  <- shuffled_markers[(floor(n_markers / 2) + 1):n_markers]

cat("Clustering markers (", length(clustering_markers), "):\n")
print(clustering_markers)

cat("\nValidation markers (", length(validation_markers), "):\n")
print(validation_markers)


# 3 Cluster using clustering markers only

VariableFeatures(codex.obj) <- clustering_markers

codex.obj <- RunPCA(
  object = codex.obj,
  features = clustering_markers,
  npcs = 20,
  reduction.name = "pca_cluster",
  reduction.key = "PCclust_",
  verbose = FALSE
)

codex.obj <- FindNeighbors(codex.obj, reduction = "pca_cluster", dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
codex.obj <- FindClusters(codex.obj, resolution = 0.4, n.start = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

codex.obj <- RunUMAP(codex.obj, reduction = "pca_cluster", dims = 1:20, seed.use = 0, verbose = FALSE)

cat("\nCluster counts:\n")
print(table(Idents(codex.obj)))


# 4 Separate PCA using only validation markers

n_val_pcs <- min(20, length(validation_markers) - 1)

codex.obj <- ScaleData(codex.obj, features = validation_markers)

codex.obj <- RunPCA(
  object = codex.obj,
  features = validation_markers,
  npcs = n_val_pcs,
  reduction.name = "pca_validation",
  reduction.key = "PCval_",
  verbose = FALSE
)

#Save all for python use

clustering_pca_embeddings <- Embeddings(codex.obj, reduction = "pca_cluster")
write.csv(clustering_pca_embeddings, "pca_embeddings_clustering_new.csv", row.names = TRUE)

validation_pca_embeddings <- Embeddings(codex.obj, reduction = "pca_validation")
write.csv(validation_pca_embeddings, "pca_embeddings_validation.csv", row.names = TRUE)

clusters <- data.frame(
  CellID = Cells(codex.obj),
  cluster = as.character(Idents(codex.obj))
)
write.csv(clusters, "clusters_new_new.csv", row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(codex.obj, "codex_split_feature_new.rds")

cat("\nSaved: pca_embeddings_clustering_new.csv, pca_embeddings_validation.csv, clusters_new_new.csv\n")
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# 1 Loading Raw data and building Seurat object

mesmer.fp <- "NSCLC.0--mesmer_cell.csv"

main.matrix <- data.frame(fread(mesmer.fp), check.names = FALSE)
main.matrix[, "CellID"] <- paste0("CellID_", main.matrix[, "CellID"])
rownames(main.matrix) <- main.matrix[, "CellID"]

quant.matrix <- main.matrix[, 2:(grep("X_centroid", fixed = TRUE, colnames(main.matrix)) - 1)]
rownames(quant.matrix) <- main.matrix[, "CellID"]
quant.matrix <- t(quant.matrix)   # markers = rows, cells = columns

centroid.matrix <- main.matrix[, c("X_centroid", "Y_centroid", "CellID")]
colnames(centroid.matrix) <- c("x", "y", "cell")

meta.matrix <- main.matrix[, colnames(main.matrix)[c(1, grep("Area", colnames(main.matrix), fixed = TRUE):ncol(main.matrix))]]
colnames(meta.matrix)[1] <- "cell_id"

coords <- suppressWarnings(CreateFOV(coords = centroid.matrix, type = "centroids", key = "fov", assay = "Akoya"))
colnames(meta.matrix) <- suppressWarnings(make.names(colnames(meta.matrix)))

codex.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = quant.matrix, assay = "Akoya", meta.data = meta.matrix)
coords <- subset(coords, cells = Cells(codex.obj))
suppressWarnings(codex.obj[["fov"]] <- coords)

codex.obj <- NormalizeData(codex.obj, normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
codex.obj <- ScaleData(codex.obj)

# Ranking markers by row-wise variance across cells

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(codex.obj, assay = "Akoya", layer = "data") 

marker_cols <- setdiff(rownames(codex.obj), "Keratin-14")  

marker_variance <- apply(expr_matrix[marker_cols, ], 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
marker_variance_sorted <- sort(marker_variance, decreasing = TRUE)

top_most_variable <- names(marker_variance_sorted)[1:30]
bottom_least_variable <- names(marker_variance_sorted)[
  (length(marker_variance_sorted) - 29):length(marker_variance_sorted)
]
n_split<-30
cat("Top", n_split, "most variable markers:\n")
print(top_most_variable)

cat("\nBottom", n_split, "least variable markers:\n")
print(bottom_least_variable)

write.csv(
  data.frame(marker = names(marker_variance_sorted), variance = marker_variance_sorted),
  "marker_variance_ranking.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
#Obtain two different sets of validation and cluster data: 
# Round 1: cluster on LEAST variable, validate on MOST variable

set.seed(0)

run1 <- codex.obj

VariableFeatures(run1) <- bottom_least_variable
run1 <- RunPCA(run1, features = bottom_least_variable, npcs = 20,
               reduction.name = "pca_cluster", reduction.key = "PCclust_", verbose = FALSE)
run1 <- FindNeighbors(run1, reduction = "pca_cluster", dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
run1 <- FindClusters(run1, resolution = 0.4, n.start = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

run1 <- ScaleData(run1, features = top_most_variable)
run1 <- RunPCA(run1, features = top_most_variable, npcs = 20,
               reduction.name = "pca_validation", reduction.key = "PCval_", verbose = FALSE)

write.csv(Embeddings(run1, "pca_validation"), "round1_pca_validation.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(
  data.frame(CellID = Cells(run1), cluster = as.character(Idents(run1))),
  "round1_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nRound 1 cluster counts:\n")
print(table(Idents(run1)))


#Round 2: cluster on MOST variable, validate on LEAST variable

set.seed(0)

run2 <- codex.obj

VariableFeatures(run2) <- top_most_variable
run2 <- RunPCA(run2, features = top_most_variable, npcs = 20,
               reduction.name = "pca_cluster", reduction.key = "PCclust_", verbose = FALSE)
run2 <- FindNeighbors(run2, reduction = "pca_cluster", dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
run2 <- FindClusters(run2, resolution = 0.4, n.start = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

run2 <- ScaleData(run2, features = bottom_least_variable)
run2 <- RunPCA(run2, features = bottom_least_variable, npcs = 20,
               reduction.name = "pca_validation", reduction.key = "PCval_", verbose = FALSE)

write.csv(Embeddings(run2, "pca_validation"), "round2_pca_validation.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(
  data.frame(CellID = Cells(run2), cluster = as.character(Idents(run2))),
  "round2_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nRound 2 cluster counts:\n")
print(table(Idents(run2)))

cat("\nDone. Add these 4 files to Python: round1_pca_validation.csv, round1_clusters.csv, round2_pca_validation.csv, round2_clusters.csv\n")
```
